After an unusually long three-week wait, developers can now begin downloading new beta updates, including iPadOS 27 beta 5, among other versions. Here's what you need to know.

iPadOS 27 beta 5 and more Apple updates now available

There's just over a month to go until the public launch of iOS 27. That usually means the beta release cycle is about to ramp up.

Apple today pushed out beta 5 for several systems, including iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27.

For now, only developers can download and install these new updates. However, if Apple sticks to its usual pattern, public betas of these software versions should be available within a day or two.

At this stage of the beta cycle, we don't expect to find any major user-facing changes in Apple software. Instead, August is typically when two main things happen during Apple's beta testing:

  • New betas arrive more frequently, usually on a weekly basis, but with noticeably fewer visible changes
  • Apple's focus shifts toward bug fixes and performance improvements

Apple has emphasized that iOS 27 and other systems will deliver performance gains over their predecessors.

While there's already been a degree of improvement in the betas, expect Apple's new software to run more smoothly and squash more bugs in beta 5 and over the coming weeks.

That said, if any new features or notable changes surface in today's update, we'll let you know.

Spotted anything new in iPadOS 27 beta 5 or any of the other updates? Tell us about it in the comments.
